addIngredient(uint256,string,uint256).details: Checks if the ingredient is in stock in supplierChecks if the required quantity of the ingredient is availableChecks if the specified ingredient is already in the order list

params._ingredient: The specific ingredient to be added
params._qty: The quantity of the ingredient specified
params.orderId: The ID of the order where the ingredients will added

checkoutOrder(uint256).details: It sets the final price before all the verification on the side of supplierReduces stock as well

params.orderId: Specifies the ID of the order to be computed

copyLastOrder(uint256).details: Has the same details from the last order but the date

params.date: The date used to specify delivery date plus block timestamp

createOrder(uint256).details: Doesn't set the details, but just instantiates an order

params._deliverydate: Adds the delivery date to the present block timestamp

editOrder(uint256,string,uint256).details: Uses keccak256 hashing since Solidity can't compare strings

params._ingredient: Specifies the ingredient which quantity will be changed
params._qty: Specifies the new quantity of the ingredient specified

params.orderId: The ID of the order that needs to be referenced

returns._0: ingredients The list of ingredients of the order

orderArrived(uint256).details: Changes issueStatus to UnderInvestigation for quality check
